description: This file contains React components and utility functions related to emoji selection and display within a chat application, including emoji URL generation, an avatar picker component, and avatar display components.

methods.name: getEmojiUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for emoji images based on their unified code and style, utilizing a CDN.

methods.name: AvatarPicker
methods.description: A React component rendering an emoji picker widget, triggering a callback with the selected emoji's unified code.

methods.name: Avatar
methods.description: A React component displaying either a bot icon based on the model type or an emoji avatar if provided.

methods.name: EmojiAvatar
methods.description: A React component rendering an emoji image with specified size, using the getEmojiUrl function.
